### Observed differences

- Activity A02 was not observed in the earlier window (0 of 200 traces); in the later window it occurs in every trace, exactly once per case, always at the final position of the trace. [OCC001, POS001]
- The relationship between A02 and A05 changed fundamentally: earlier, A05 appeared without A02 in all 200 traces (co-occurrence 0%); in the later window, both activities occur together in every trace, with A05 before A02 in 100% of them. [REL001]
- A05's outgoing transitions: earlier, none were observed from A05, consistent with it being the last step in every trace; in the later window, all observed outgoing transitions of A05 lead to A02. [DIR001]
- A05's relative position moved earlier: from exactly 1.0 (the last position) in every earlier trace to a median of about 0.86 in the later window, a shift of roughly 0.15 on the position scale, making room for A02 after it. [POS002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that, in the later window, a new mandatory step A02 is executed once per case immediately after A05, which previously ended the process. The supporting signs are direct and mutually consistent: A02 went from unobserved (0 of 200 traces) to occurring in all 200 traces exactly once; the relational evidence shows A05 before A02 in every later trace, where earlier A05 always appeared alone; the directional evidence shows every observed outgoing transition of A05 now leads to A02; and A05's position shifted from the last position to about 86% through the trace, exactly what appending A02 at the end would produce. [OCC001, POS001, REL001, DIR001, POS002]

The volume of qualifying evidence far exceeds what an unchanged process typically produces: five items qualified where about 0.06 would be expected by chance (control-flow family, 12 units tested), and each item's difference was larger than in about 99.5 of 100 random re-splits of the pooled traces. [POS002, POS001, REL001, DIR001, OCC001]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window strictly means only that A02 was not observed there, so a pre-existing but extremely rare A02 cannot be fully excluded, although its absence from all 200 earlier traces makes a frequently executed pre-existing step unlikely. The five items describe one underlying difference and are not independent confirmations. The evidence covers only A02 and A05, so whether A02 complements or replaces other end-of-process behaviour outside these two activities cannot be determined from this sample.
